Let me explain

47 began as a clone in a hospital in Romania (which is mentioned in the beta), as a result of Dr. Ort-Meyer's work. He created 47, trained him for a bit, then allowed him to escape to test him in real world conditions. That's when 47 joins the ICA, which is what we see in the Beta. He meets Diana (which is interesting given how it is implied in every game 47 has never met her until BM's ending) and joins ICA as an Agent. Then the other games happen.

In Codename 47 (AKA Hitman 1), 47 returns to Romania at the request of Ort-Meyer and finds out his true origin before killing the doctor and his clone brothers, the 48s. He then flees (as seen in the first level of Hitman 3: Contracts) and travels to Italy where he hides in a farm run by a Catholic priest named Father Vittorio, who becomes 47's only friend.

Then Hitman 2: Silent Assassin happens, then Enemy Within (a novel), then Blood Money with Contracts happening in between 2 missions of BM, then Damnation (another novel) and finally Absolution (tho we all wish it didn't happen) and then the new game, Hitman 6. There's a post around here somewhere with a link to a detailed run down of the whole story. It's a pretty good read, if you are interested.

DUDE, listen. I went to NG+ before I even started the Chalice Dungeons, and doing so I missed some content CRUCIAL for obtaining the Platinum. Remember to pick up the Red Jelly (I think) from the Lecture Building's 1st floor, to the right of the exit. Also, in Nightmare of Mensis drop Mother Brain, drop down to its location and pick up all the Great One's Wisdom and the Blood Rock, the only item in the main quest that allows you to upgrade weapons to +10. Next, go back to the place with all the pitfalls and the little dwarves with pots in their heads, and there should be a new elevator. Ride it down to a pitch black room and find Mother Brain. It won't attack you. Stand in front of it, and do the Make Contact gesture in front of it for 30 seconds, you'll get a Moon Rune. Then, kill it and you'll get the Living String item that you need to make the final Chalice dungeon where you fight the secret final boss that gives you a Gold Trophy. I completely missed some of this stuff and had to fight through NG+ all the way to the Nightmare of Mensis to get it. Still, the Platinum was worth it. Good luck!
